;Armed conflicts and attacks
*Two women, one of them pregnant, are killed and seven others are injured when artillery hits a [[Rohingya]] village in [[Rakhine State]]. The locals blame [[Myanmar]]'s [[Tatmadaw|armed forces]]. The armed forces deny responsibility and blame the [[Arakan Army (Kachin State)|Arakan Army]], and say the artillery hit the village amid ethnic clashes. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-myanmar-rohingya/two-rohingya-women-killed-as-myanmar-army-shells-village-mp-idUSKBN1ZO08H (Reuters)]
*[[2019–2021 Iraqi protests]]
**Iraqi security forces raid a protest site in [[Baghdad]] and try to remove protesters in southern cities, firing [[tear gas]] and live bullets, killing four and wounding dozens more. The raid comes after [[Muqtada al-Sadr]] ordered his followers to withdraw. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iraq-protests/iraqi-security-forces-raid-protest-camps-4-killed-after-sadr-supporters-withdraw-idUSKBN1ZO0AN?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[General Secretary of the Communist Party of China]] [[Xi Jinping]] holds a special [[Politburo of the Communist Party of China|Party Politburo]] meeting where he says that the country faces a "grave situation" as he warns the virus is "accelerating its speed". [http://en.people.cn/n3/2020/0125/c90000-9651799.html (''People's Daily'')]
**The [[United States]] orders the evacuation of the [[Consulate General of the United States, Wuhan]] employees and U.S. citizens in the city. [https://www.nytimes.com/2020/01/25/world/asia/china-coronavirus.html#link-3db7b2fe (''The New York Times'')]

;Science and technology
*The [[Boeing 777X]] completes its first test flight near [[Seattle]], [[Washington (state)|Washington]], United States, after two delayed attempts. [https://www.cnn.com/travel/article/boeing-777x-9-first-flight/index.html (CNN)]
